frame: origin at the front middle of 圆明园殿's box F0018 at its ground; x east along the front, y up, z south (scripts/model_site.py)

ymy_bays.note: 圆明园殿 five bays, 明间一丈三尺, 四次间各一丈二尺 (NLC 样007-9-1 of 1855.3, the yellow slip as transcribed on mhymy record 11195; the same on the 1837 sheet); 19.52 m between the end columns

ymy_depth.note: 进深二丈二尺 between the 金柱 lines, front and back porches 各深六尺 (same slip): 10.88 m between the eave columns

ymy_edge.note: 下檐出二尺九寸 (same slip): the platform's edge beyond the eave columns

ymy_roof.note: record 11195 reads 墀头 on the gables of the 1837 and 1855 sheets and infers a 硬山 roof after the fire (the record author's inference); the 1744 leaf drew a 歇山 (Q100); rolled ridge: the 1745 woodcut's curved ridge ends (S76); grey: the leaf (S08)

ymy_doors.value: door screens on the 金柱 line, open porches
ymy_doors.note: record 11195: in 1837 the 隔扇 were moved to the 金柱 line; the 1745 woodcut draws an open verandah (S76)

ymy_plaque.value: 圆明园, Kangxi's hand, on the front eave
ymy_plaque.note: S05 j80:1b, 21a 前第一層殿恭懸聖祖御書圓明園額; record 7105 前檐悬; the board's size and colours C

ymy_ears.value: two-cell ear rooms at both ends
ymy_ears.note: S01 draws a two-cell block at each end of the hall, flush with its front half; read as ear rooms 耳房, their form the class's

yard.value: walled yard from the hall to the shore, landing
yard.note: S01 draws two lines from the hall's front to the shore and the label inside; the landing YMC-023 (Round 9) on the shore; the walls 1.4 m (C); Malone's caption of the 1744 woodcut: reeds and rocks at the water's edge before the hall (S02 p.78): rocks either side outside the yard (C)

court1.value: S01's: 34.5 m deep (eave columns), 22.6 m between the walls' inner faces
court1.note: S01 places the halls and the walls (re-read in plan pixels); the Tongzhi survey (NLC 样006-3 = 样062-24, 1873-74, quoted in mhymy record 11901) writes 圆明园殿后檐至奉三无私前檐10丈6尺 = 33.92 m (S01 within 0.6 m) and 东西宽8丈1尺2寸 = 25.98 m: 3.4 m wider than S01's walls, which would cut the halls S01 draws beside them; the plan is kept (Q250)

court2.note: S01 places 九洲清晏殿's front behind 奉三无私殿's; the Tongzhi survey writes 5丈7尺1寸 = 18.27 m (样006-3), perhaps for the Tongzhi design's deeper 双卷 hall: the plan's position is kept (Q250)

fs_bays.note: 七楹 (S05 j80:20b, A); 前后有廊 (record 7271, B); S01 draws the hall wall to wall, 23.3 m with its edges; the widths C, the middle bay widest as in 圆明园殿's slip

fs_depth.note: between the eave columns, 圆明园殿's section carried over (C); the hall's middle where S01 draws it

fs_col.note: one 尺 above 圆明园殿 (C): the second hall of the axis; 慎德堂 on the same island measures 4.35 m (record 7342)

fs_pl.note: a little above 圆明园殿's 0.704 m (C)

fs_roof.note: the 1744 leaf: 歇山, ridge apparently rolled, grey tile (S08 P0003, a reading); rebuilt 'to the old form' in 1837 (E1134)

fs_terrace.note: S01 draws a rectangle before the hall (about 20 by 5.2 m); its height a step below the hall's floor (C)

jz_bays.note: five bays (record 7237, A for 1855; S05 says 七楹 for the 1780s, Q101, Q163); the widths C, to S01's drawn 18.1 m

jz_depth.note: 前后有廊 (record 7237, A); 圆明园殿's section carried over (C)

jz_pl.note: P0365 shows the hall's site as a low mound against the back lake; the platform C

jz_roof.value: rolled 歇山, grey, the largest roof of the island
jz_roof.note: the 1744 leaf: the biggest roof on the island, 歇山, the ridge reads as rolled (not certain) (S08 P0003)

jz_baosha.value: 3 bays, 4.16 m deep, behind the hall
jz_baosha.note: 后殿五间接后抱厦三间 (record 7237); 样005-27-1 is the design and the work was done in 咸丰五年 (1855) (record 10881); its depth and roof C

jz_plaques.value: 九洲清晏 front, 蔚然深秀 rear
jz_plaques.note: S05 j80:21a, 23a: Yongzheng's plaque in front, 蔚然深秀 at the back; boards C

tongdao.value: the link and 同道堂 at their boxes
tongdao.note: the approved rebuilding gave the hall's west side the 同道堂 annex (样010-3, E1169); S01 draws a three-cell link and a three-bay hall there (F0569, F0022); their forms the class's

walls.note: S01 draws the walls of the axis; the leaf paints the island's walls white with grey coping (S08 P0003); height C

galleries.value: covered galleries along the courts' sides
galleries.note: the 1744 leaf shows covered galleries with white walls and a row of pierced windows between the axis halls (S08 P0003); where they run is C (S01 draws only the walls)

gates.value: a gate in each side wall of the first court
gates.note: the leaf shows a red gate in a white wall beside the front hall (east); the west one mirrored, both C

vessels.note: S01's two marks in the first court; vessels as at the other courts of the garden (C)

trees.note: the leaf: pink-flowering trees (peach or apricot) all through the courts (S08 P0003, species B); four, places C

bridges.value: stone abutments, timber deck, red railings
bridges.note: the leaf: a flat timber bridge with red-brown railings on the island's west side and a stepped timber bridge with railings at its south-east (S08 P0003, A for 1744); today's 南大桥 and 如意桥 rebuilt on dressed-stone abutments (P0367, P0793, B); decks at Round 10's levels

zongting.note: the name 棕亭桥 (S01, read as a guess) and today's rebuilt pavilion bridge (P0368, B for the type); the pavilion's size and roof C

landings.value: dressed-stone landings with steps to the water
landings.note: Round 9's landings YMC-023 (front) and YMC-031 (back) on S01's shores; M'Ghee and the 1860 witnesses reached the apartments by water and paths (S02 pp.180-183); the steps C
